You can pin 2 apps. Long-press a pinned one on the left to remove it first.
No navigation app found. Long-press the map to pick one.

Shows a floating home button and lets you swipe up from the bottom of the screen to go home. It hides itself in apps you choose. It only reads the screen in Settings, to switch the Wi-Fi hotspot on or off for you.

In the next screen, find \"%1$s\" and switch it on.\n\nIf Android says it\'s a restricted setting: open Settings → Apps → DriveDeck, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.

Automatic (light by day, dark after sunset)

To show your recently used apps on the left, switch on DriveDeck under \"Usage access\" on the next screen.\n\nIf Android says it\'s a restricted setting: open Settings → Apps → DriveDeck, tap the ⋮ menu, choose \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.

No back screen found. Is it on and connected to the TBox hotspot, with KidsDeck as its home screen?

Quickest: in the YouTube app, tap Share → Copy link. Then on DriveDeck, long-press the small screen button on the now-playing card, or tap it and choose "Play copied YouTube link in the back". The back screen plays the same video and follows play, pause and skipping.

Or: in YouTube, Share → More → "Play in the back".

For Netflix and Prime: choose "Open … in the back" here and pick the same episode on both screens. After that, pausing or playing at the front does the same in the back.

Only while parked, for example when charging.

Switch on the DriveDeck home button service (long-press the clock → Home button and swipe up) so DriveDeck can switch the hotspot for you.

Tip: in the hotspot settings, switch off \"Turn off hotspot automatically\", otherwise Android turns it off when the back screens are off for a while.
Is the back ahead of the sound at the front? Press +. Behind? Press −.
In YouTube, Netflix or Prime: Share → Copy link, then tap this. Together: plays along with YouTube at the front. Back only: plays on its own.
